data.other_hard: legal U.S. resident of one of the Eligible States (AL, AR, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, KY, LA, MS, MO, NC, SC, TN, TX); age 16 or older; at least one year (or 18 semester hours) remaining before undergraduate graduation; if not yet in college, begin freshman year no later than the start of the 2027-2028 academic year; cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in school; written essay (500 words or less) or video essay in English about an individual known personally who lives in the applicant's community; prize must be used toward tuition and undergraduate expenses at an accredited nonprofit two- or four-year college in the US
data.evidence_sentence: Quarterly Contest prizes may not be used toward graduate school (post graduate) tuition or other post-undergraduate program expenses.
data.notes: Name and URL say Black History Scholarship but the page describes the 2026 Regions Riding Forward Scholarship Contest, with four quarterly contests (Q-1 to Q-4) and four $8,000 awards per contest; the page does not state a nationality rule, only U.S. residence in listed states, which is placed in other_hard; the Q-1 to Q-3 deadlines have passed as of 2026-11-21 and Q-4 closes 2026-12-31; the page gives no subject restriction; the GPA scale is not stated; page text includes winner announcement dates and essay/AI rules that were not treated as eligibility criteria.
